historical_product: WorldClim v1.4 CMIP5 LGM ~22,000 years before present (not exactly dated 21,000 BP)
independent_history_information_metric: Response-blind out-of-fold squared residual of GCM LGM BIO1/BIO12 after current climate and geography; report absolute residual standard deviation and fraction relative to LGM variance, by continent and GCM
matched_baseline_product: WorldClim v1.4 bioclimatic 1960-1990 (paired calibration baseline; obsolete and for sensitivity within this historical product only)
original_modern_climate_product: WorldClim v2.1 1970-2000 at 30 arc seconds; original file is z standardized and not directly paired with v1.4 downscaled paleoclimate
positive_diagnostic_requires: Read and verify original GCM file bytes, integrity and raster CRS, six variable units and nodata; access success is not climatic signal
Extract six LGM and matching baseline variables at original 96 source IDs; report missingness and count distinct raster cell IDs
Exclude any source location without both paired present and LGM values; do not replace source by garden or nearest site
Report within continent source-level historical change versus contemporary climate and geographic polynomial controls
Spatial block folds must be defined before opening LGM response; no fitness response in qualification
Compare CCSM4 primary conclusion with MIROC-ESM and MPI-ESM-P sensitivities; do not cherry pick models
Decide whether a new fitness confirmation is feasible only after additional independent cohort and frozen holdout/power
projection: WGS84 latitude/longitude with source-population locations, not garden proxies
spatial_block_design: Within each continent five source-latitude quintile bands (10 prespecified blocks), no random split of individual garden rows
